key_insight: Claw-Eval-Live makes agent evaluation continuous and verifiable by decoupling a refreshable 'signal' layer from core tasks, enabling benchmarks that evolve with real-world workflow demand and check execution side-effects, not just final text outputs.
problem_solved: Static, frozen benchmarks fail to track changing workflow needs and cannot reliably verify whether agents actually executed multi-step, tool- and service-driven tasks in real environments.
method: Design a live benchmark architecture that separates a stable task core from a refreshable signal layer updated across releases to reflect evolving workflow demand.
Instrument end-to-end execution paths (software tools, business services, local workspaces) to capture verifiable side-effects and outcomes rather than only final textual responses.
Provide continuous release mechanics and evaluation metrics that combine response quality with execution fidelity (e.g., state changes, API calls, file edits) to score agents.
impact: Enables researchers and practitioners to measure agent reliability and real-world usefulness over time, improving trust, robustness, and deployment readiness for workflow automation systems.
visual_elements: Architecture diagram: core tasks vs. refreshable signal layer with arrows showing update cadence and separation of concerns.
Workflow flowchart: agent interacting with tools, services, and local workspace with an observability/verification layer capturing side-effects.
Timeline or release cadence chart: evolving task set across releases with changing signals and how benchmark scores track over time.
Comparison bar chart: static frozen benchmark vs. Claw-Eval-Live showing differences in detected execution failures and real-world coverage.
paper_title: Claw-Eval-Live: A Live Agent Benchmark for Evolving Real-World Workflows
paper_authors: Chenxin Li, Zhengyang Tang, Huangxin Lin, Yunlong Lin, Shijue Huang
